activities.name: Landing on Skellig Michael
activities.note: landing and cruising are two different tickets with two different seasons — the island itself is only walkable in the middle of the year

windows.reason: landing tours run mid-May to the end of September, and this is peak puffin season on the island
the later part of the landing season
boat tours circle the island from mid-March to early November, but without landing

activities.name: Cliffs of Moher
activities.note: the clifftop is open all year; it is the boat tours beneath it that have a season

windows.reason: boats run from Doolin March to September and from Galway April to September, which is the only way to see the cliffs from below
